items.title: Show HN: Faztudo, a local chat for coordinating the coding agents CLIs
items.contentSnippet:
Faztudo is a local workspace, that divides agent works into chats, projects, departments.
It is similar, but more flexible, than Grokbot. You can coordinate the usage of Grok, Gemini, Kimi, Claude, Codex, Opencode, etc.
It has also a 2d and 3d visualization of the work being performed.
The license is MIT.

items.title: Show HN: Civ 1 period accurate decompilation
items.contentSnippet:
I've used LLMs to decompile Civ 1 and put the reconstructed C source on GitHub, along with a technical book and story.
The reconstructed source builds with what i'm pretty sure is the original Microsoft C compiler and toolchain. It produces a byte-for-byte match with the original executable, aside from a four-byte correction for what appears to be a patch applied after linking. So it should be pretty close to how the original game was made; although it can't be said that this is the "original so

items.title: Show HN: FlexChords – chords for any YouTube song, from a model I trained
items.contentSnippet:
I play guitar, and chord charts online were often wrong or oversimplified for the songs I wanted to learn, so I built FlexChords. You can edit the detected chords, transpose, and export to MIDI.
1-minute demo: https://youtu.be/-cbL3L3UnGs
It's still a work in progress. I'd love to hear where it gets chords wrong and any other feedback.

items.contentSnippet:
